SegmentInput.description: Input of the RunAgentSegment activity: one bounded slice of an agent run, which the worker executes as a single DeepAgent invocation. Kept small (under 8 KiB); anything large is passed by reference.

member.description: Who executes the segment: the literal agent for a single-agent run, the roster name for a team member.

seq.description: Segment number within the (run, member), starting at 1. With run_id and member it is the idempotency key of the segment.

agent_session_key.description: Key of the agent conversation state (checkpoint) this segment continues; one per (run, member) or per session.

expected_checkpoint_version.description: Checkpoint version the segment must start from. The commit is a compare-and-swap to this value plus one.

steer.description: Course corrections from the user that arrived while the run was active, oldest first, injected before the model call.

mailbox.description: Team messages delivered to this member since its last segment, oldest first. Present only for team members.

capability_token.description: Run-scoped bearer token for the control internal API (audience kernel). It carries no more than the run's rights and expires with the segment.

event_subject.description: NATS subject the worker publishes run events to, run.<tenant>.<run>.

SegmentLockRef.description: The run lock the segment executes: the exact resolved versions of the agent, its skills and MCP servers.

id.description: Lock identifier, the lock_id of the RunLock.

digest.description: Digest of the lock content; the worker compiles and caches by it.

SegmentTurnKind.description: What starts the segment: a new user message, the answer to an interaction that parked the run, a follow-up (steer or mailbox delivery), or a plain continuation after a yield.

SegmentTurn.description: The trigger of the segment. user_message needs content_ref or text; interactive_input needs interaction_id and decision.

content_ref.description: Object store reference of the message content when it is too large to inline.

SteerItem.description: One steering message from the user.

content_ref.description: Object store reference of the content.

MailboxMessage.description: A message another team member (or the leader) sent to this member.

message_id.description: Message identifier, unique within the team run.

content_ref.description: Object store reference of the content when it is too large to inline.

SegmentLimits.description: Bounds of one segment; the segment yields when any of them is reached.

max_iterations.description: Maximum ReAct iterations in the segment.

max_wall_seconds.description: Wall-clock bound of the segment; the worker stops the agent before the activity timeout.

segment_budget_credits.description: Credits this segment may spend before it yields with budget_soft.

remaining_run_credits.description: Credits left in the run budget at the start of the segment.

BudgetNotice.description: none, or soft_warning once the run has consumed its warning share of the budget; the agent is told to wrap up.

SegmentSandbox.description: The sandbox lease the segment runs its tools in, acquired by the workflow before the segment.

isolated_session_id.description: Isolated session inside a shared sandbox, used for team members.

TeamTaskBrief.description: The task a teammate or reviewer works on in this segment.

task_id.description: Task identifier on the team board.

description.description: What to do and what done looks like.

spec_ref.description: Object store reference of a longer specification.

narrowed_tools.description: Tools the leader restricted the task to; empty means the member's full tool set. It can only narrow, never widen.

TeamContext.description: Present when the segment belongs to a team run.

team_workflow_id.description: Workflow ID of the TeamRunWorkflow; team tools call its Updates.
